title: It didn’t work with Alabama's powerful summer sun.
text: It didn’t work with Alabama's powerful summer sun.. Only worked  on and off. There seem to be no perfect days of sun to keep it going for more than a few minutes. It was in a bird bath with full sunlight  but didn’t work very often. Very disappointing. We have lots of summer sun in Alabama.
